questions.prompt: How many total litres of water are contained within all active municipal water distribution reservoirs in Australia?
reasoning: Australia has a population of approximately 26 million people living mostly in urban water networks.
Average daily household and municipal water consumption is roughly 200 litres per person, requiring substantial storage buffers.
Major municipal reservoirs and service tanks collectively store roughly one week to several weeks of total urban demand, equating to about 4.5 billion litres.

questions.prompt: How many total individual seeds are contained within all fresh watermelons harvested across commercial farms in Spain in a single year?
reasoning: Spain produces approximately 1.2 million tonnes of watermelons annually.
An average medium-to-large commercial watermelon weighs about 5 kilograms, resulting in roughly 240 million individual watermelons harvested per year.
Each typical watermelon contains an estimated 500 to 1,500 seeds inside the pulp, averaging around 1,450 seeds per fruit to yield about 350 billion total seeds.

questions.prompt: How many total individual words are spoken by all air traffic controllers on duty at major commercial airports across the United States during a single standard twenty-four-hour day?
reasoning: There are around 500 major commercial airports in the United States with active air traffic control towers operating around the clock.
Each active controller or sector handles dozens of radio transmissions per hour, speaking at a fast pace of roughly 150 words per minute.
Multiplying active operational hours, active positions, and continuous dialogue yields a total of approximately 12 million spoken words nationwide per day.
